messages:
maya_oncall: FYI support ticket #12345 — AcmeCorp seeing intermittent 504/502 from hosted inference in euw1 since ~03:08 UTC, SLO alert fired. customer says timeouts on heavy batch requests.
triage_bot: ALERT: hosted-infer.euw1 p95 latency > SLO (03:07-03:13) — ticket 12345.
lina_support: attaching customer logs they pasted: `{'status':504,'error':'upstream timeout','trace':'tr-9f8b'}` — they see ~15% 5xx on /v1/generate routes.
jordan_sre: copying. Any recent deploys or config changes to gateway/edge-proxy before 03:00?
ben_platform: there was a rolling config push to edge-proxy (conn-timeout tuning) at 02:56 UTC — pipeline shows small window of restarts on 02:57-02:59.
maya_oncall: customer is on dedicated capacity but using hosted gateway + region routing. They report retries don't help.
jordan_sre: running quick log query: `logs.query("service:gateway AND region:euw1 AND status:5xx | count() by minute, route")` — spike at 03:08 for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.
ben_platform: also seeing authz failures correlated: `error: oauth_invalid_token` around same window. Could be token propagation issue after restart.
lina_support: customer pasted a sample header: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>` then `x-trace-id: tr-9f8b` then dropped.
jordan_sre: can someone check proxy connection pool exhaustion? If healthchecks flapped, upstream pool could be saturated and produce timeouts.
ben_platform: checking metrics: active upstream conns peaked, backend queue grew, and batcher v2 reports backlog — looks like a brief capacity pressure during the restart.
maya_oncall: also noticed traces missing for many 504s — trace sampling gap for failing requests.
jordan_sre: yeah trace headers not always present in the 504 logs — suggests proxy may be dropping/rewriting headers on failed handoffs. Need to confirm if x-trace-id propagation changed in the 02:56 config.
ben_platform: diffing the config: we removed preserve_incoming_headers: true for the hot path to reduce header copy cost. That would explain trace header loss. Oops.
lina_support: customer impact: high for a couple tenants, they ask for mitigation/rollback.
jordan_sre: immediate mitigation steps: 1) enable canary fallback routing to alternate region for that customer, 2) roll back preserve_incoming_headers change on edge-proxy, 3) increase upstream connection pool temporarily. Which one do we want first?
maya_oncall: do 1) and 3) now, 2) if 1/3 don't reduce errors. Can someone run the canary route change? @ben_platform can you? :pray: 
ben_platform: starting canary routing for AcmeCorp -> route through euw2 now. Also bumped upstream pool size by +30%.
ninja_steps: runscope_bot posted deploy job: `deploy edge-proxy config v2026-03-17-0256 -> rollback candidate v2026-03-17-0240`
jordan_sre: after canary + pool bump error rate dropped from 15% -> 2% for the customer, p95 latency recovered. Still need rollback to fully restore trace propagation and avoid recurrence.
lina_support: updated customer: temporary routing applied, they confirm reduced failures. They're asking for ETA on full fix.
maya_oncall: ETA for rollback?
ben_platform: pre-approving rollback now — will schedule immediate roll back to v2026-03-17-0240, will monitor for 10m.
jordan_sre: post-rollback, confirm traces and headers present and no authz spikes. Also add regression test for preserve_incoming_headers flag in canary.
maya_oncall: please create incident ticket and link to support ticket #12345, add postmortem owner.
ben_platform: incident created: INC-2026-0456, assigned to jordan_sre for triage + postmortem.
jordan_sre: assigning follow-ups: (1) postmortem + root cause (config change removed header propagation) (2) add automated dashboard alert for missing x-trace-id fraction > 5% (3) add canary test that sends heavy batched requests across restarts.
lina_support: customer satisfied with workaround, requesting written summary.
maya_oncall: thanks team. marking P1 -> mitigated. Will keep monitoring for next 24h. :thumbsup:
